title: Amgen reports positive Phase 3 data for dazodalibep in Sjögren's disease | Clinical Observer
summary:
Amgen said in a press release that dazodalibep, its investigational CD40 ligand antagonist fusion protein, met the primary endpoint in the Phase 3 OASIZ-301 trial for patients with moderate-to-severe Sjögren's disease. The primary endpoint was change from baseline at 48 weeks on the EULAR Sjögren's Syndrome Disease Activity Index, or ESSDAI.

The release described the study as global, randomized, double-blind and placebo-controlled, enrolling 648 patients with an ESSDAI score of at least 5.
